# nyx

> nyx is an interface-first TypeScript framework for Discord bots. It handles application commands, events, schedules and plugins on top of discord.js (`@nyx-discord/djs`) or @discordjs/core (`@nyx-discord/djs-core`).

- Import everything from the adapter the project uses (`@nyx-discord/djs` or `@nyx-discord/djs-core`); both re-export `@nyx-discord/base`.
- Every page below is plain Markdown. Pages show both adapters in `<Tab>` blocks: use the one matching the project. Ignore twoslash lines in code blocks (`// ---cut---`, `// @ts-expect-error`, `// ^?`) and `declare const` stubs.
- nyx only supports application commands, never replies to users on errors by itself, and doesn't ship storage: those are the bot's own code.
- Agent skill with typechecked examples: `npx skills add nyx-discord/nyx` (source: https://github.com/nyx-discord/nyx/tree/main/skills/nyx).
- All pages in one file: https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/llms-full.txt
- API reference: https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/docs/

## Docs

- Use: How to use nyx and its features.
  - [Introduction](https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/use.md)
  - [Packages](https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/use/packages.md): Explore the packages that make up nyx
  - [Start](https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/use/first-start.md): Getting started with nyx
  - HTTP Bots
    - [HTTP Overview](https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/use/http.md)
    - [Mounting](https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/use/http/mounting.md): Connect the client to your server or runtime.
    - [Handling requests](https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/use/http/requests.md): How the client answers Discord, and how commands reply.
    - Serverless
      - [Serverless](https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/use/http/serverless.md): Run an HTTP bot on serverless platforms like Cloudflare Workers, Vercel or AWS Lambda.
      - [Cloudflare Workers](https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/use/http/serverless/cloudflare-workers.md): Run an HTTP bot on Cloudflare Workers.
      - [Vercel](https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/use/http/serverless/vercel.md): Run an HTTP bot on Vercel Functions.
      - [Netlify](https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/use/http/serverless/netlify.md): Run an HTTP bot on Netlify Functions.
      - [Supabase Edge Functions](https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/use/http/serverless/supabase.md): Run an HTTP bot on Supabase Edge Functions.
      - [AWS Lambda](https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/use/http/serverless/aws-lambda.md): Run an HTTP bot on AWS Lambda with a function URL.
    - [Webhook events](https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/use/http/webhook-events.md): Receive app authorizations, entitlements and other webhook events.
    - [Configuration](https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/use/http/configuration.md): Replace the parts of the HTTP client.
